CREATE DATABASE ecommerce_project;
use ecommerce_project;
create table ecommerce_sales (
Order_ID Varchar(50),
Order_Date Date,
Customer_ID VARCHAR(50),
Customer_Name VARCHAR(100),
Product VARCHAR(100),
Category VARCHAR(100),
Quantity INT,
Unit_Price DECIMAL(12,2),
Sales DECIMAL(15,2),
Cost DECIMAL(15,2),
Profit DECIMAL(15,2),
Region VARCHAR(50),
city varchar(20),
Payment_Method varchar (30),
Customer_Type varchar(50)
);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records
FROM ecommerce_sales_raw;
SELECT *
FROM ecommerce_sales_raw
limit 10;
-- What is the total sales generated by the company?”-- 
select ROUND(sum(Sales), 0 ) As Total_Sales
from ecommerce_sales_Raw;

-- “What is the total profit generated by the company?”-- -- 
select Round(sum(Profit), 0) As Total_Profit
from ecommerce_sales_Raw;

-- “How many total units did the company sell?”
select sum(Quantity) As Total_Quantity
from ecommerce_sales_Raw;

-- “How many unique orders did the company receive?”
select  count(Distinct Order_ID) As Total_Orders
from  ecommerce_sales_raw;

-- “What is the average sales value per order?”   
select  round (sum(sales) / count(distinct Order_ID),2) as aov
from ecommerce_sales_raw;

-- “Which region generates the highest sales-- ?”
select Region, format(sum(sales), 2, 'en_in') As Total_sales
from ecommerce_sales_raw
group by region
order by sum(sales) desc;

-- “Which region generates the highest sales?”
select region, Round(sum(Profit), 0, "en_IN") As total_profit
from ecommerce_sales_raw
group by region
order by total_profit desc;


-- which product generates the highest sales
select product, format(sum(Sales), 0, 'en_in') As Total_sales
from ecommerce_sales_raw
group by product
order by sum(sales) desc;

-- Which category generates the highest sales -- 
SELECT
    Category,
    Round(SUM(Sales), 2) AS Total_Sales,
    format(sum(sales), 2, 'en_In') as Formated_sales
FROM ecommerce_sales_raw
GROUP BY Category
ORDER BY Total_Sales DESC;

-- which customer type generates the highest sales
SELECT
    Customer_Type,
    ROUND(SUM(Sales), 2) AS Total_Sales,
    format(sum(sales), 0) As Total_Sales
FROM ecommerce_sales_raw
GROUP BY Customer_Type
ORDER BY Total_Sales DESC;

-- Which payment method generates the highest sales?-- 
Select Payment_Method,Round(sum(sales), 2) As total_sales,
format(sum(sales), 2, "en_in") as format_sales
from ecommerce_sales_raw
group by Payment_Method
Order by Total_Sales Desc;

SELECT Distinct Payment_Method
FROM ecommerce_sales_raw;

-- Which payment method is used for the highest  number of orders?

select Payment_Method, count(distinct Order_Id) As Total_Orders
from ecommerce_sales_raw
group by Payment_method
order by Total_Orders Desc;

-- which citites genrates the highest sales
select city, format(sum(sales), 2, 'en_In') as Total_Sales
from ecommerce_sales_cleaned
group by city
order by Total_Sales Desc;

-- top 10 customers by profit
-- Business question: Who are the top 10 customers based on sales?
SELECT 
    Customer_Name,
    ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS Total_Sales,
    format(sum(sales), 2,"en_in") as format_sales
FROM ecommerce_sales_cleaned
GROUP BY Customer_Name
ORDER BY Total_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- which customer genreates the highest profit
select customer_name, round(sum(profit), 2) as Highest_Profit,
format(sum(profit), 2, 'en_in') as format_profit
from ecommerce_sales_cleaned
group by Customer_Name
order by Highest_Profit desc
limit 10;

-- Which month generated the highest sales?
select 
date_format(Order_Date, '%Y-%M') as Month,
format(sum(sales), 2,'en_in') as highest_sales
FROM ecommerce_sales_cleaned
group by date_format(Order_Date, '%Y-%M') 
order by Month
limit 1;

-- which month genreates the highest profit
select date_format(Order_Date, '%Y-%M') as month,
format(sum(Profit), 0, 'en_In') as highest_Profit
from ecommerce_sales_cleaned
group by date_format(order_Date, '%Y-%M')
order by month
limit 1;

-- How many orders did the company receive each month?

select
date_format(order_date, '%y %M')  as month,
count(distinct order_id) as total_orders
from ecommerce_sales_cleaned
Group by date_format(Order_date, '%y %M')
order by month;

-- what is the average sales value of each product
SELECT
    Product,
    ROUND(AVG(Sales), 2) AS Average_Sales,
    format(avg(sales), 2, 'en_in') as format_sales
FROM ecommerce_sales_cleaned
GROUP BY Product
ORDER BY Average_Sales DESC;

-- Quantity sold by product
-- which products have the highest quantity sold ?
select Product, Sum(Quantity) as Total_Quantity
from ecommerce_sales_cleaned
group by Product
Order By Total_Quantity Desc;

-- which products have the highest profit margin
SELECT
    Product,
    ROUND((SUM(Profit) / SUM(Sales)) * 100, 2) AS Profit_Margin
FROM ecommerce_sales_cleaned
GROUP BY Product
ORDER BY Profit_Margin DESC;

-- which orders appear more than once in the raw data
select order_Id, count(*) as record_count
from ecommerce_sales_cleaned
group by order_id
having count(*)> 1;

-- Missing values
-- which columns contains missing values
select sum(case when city is null or city = '' then 1 else 0 end) as missing_city,
sum(case when payment_method is null or payment_method = '' then 1 else 0 end) as missing_payment_method,
sum(case when payment_method is null or customer_type = '' then 1 else 0 end) as missing_customer_type
from ecommerce_sales_cleaned;

-- CTE analysis
-- which region have sales above the comapny's average regional sales
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT
        Region,
        SUM(Sales) AS Total_Sales
    FROM ecommerce_sales_cleaned
    GROUP BY Region
)
SELECT
    Region,
    ROUND(Total_Sales, 2) AS Total_Sales
FROM region_sales
WHERE Total_Sales > (
    SELECT AVG(Total_Sales)
    FROM region_sales
)
ORDER BY Total_Sales DESC;

-- Sales Performance Using HAVING
-- which cities generate more than 5 lakh in sales?
select city, Round(sum(sales), 2) as total_sales,
format(sum(sales), 2, "en-in") as format_sales
from ecommerce_sales_cleaned
group by city
having sum(sales) > 500000
order by total_sales desc;

-- How can customers be classified based on their sales value?
SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, round(sum(Sales), 2) as total_Sales,
case
when sum(sales) >= 100000 then 'High value'
when sum(sales) >= 50000 then 'Medium value'
else 'low value'
end as customer_segmnet
FROM ecommerce_sales_cleaned
GROUP BY Customer_Name
ORDER BY Total_Sales DESC;
